resources.string: Pick a PDF to save an unlocked copy of it. Passwords that work are saved encrypted on this phone, so similar PDFs open by themselves. Nothing leaves your phone.
This file couldn\'t be opened as a PDF. Pick another file.
The app was closed while saving. Pick the PDF again.
This PDF is locked. Enter its password.
That password didn\'t work. Check it and try again.
This PDF isn\'t locked. You can still save a copy.
Unlocked with a saved password. Save a copy without the password.
Unlocked. Save a copy without the password.
Couldn\'t save the copy. Try again, or pick a different place.
Saved. The copy opens without a password.
